    - paragraph: Ask Gemini in Chrome to explain concepts, compare tabs, or draft replies.

    - paragraph: Gemini in Chrome
    - heading "Figure it out, right in your browser" [level=3]
    - paragraph: From big tasks to small to-do’s, Gemini in Chrome is your partner in figuring it all out. You can use Gemini in Chrome to visualize information, find the right product instantly, or even check your calendar – all from your open tab.
    - link "Open in the same tab":
      - /url: /chrome/ai-innovations/
      - text: Explore Gemini in Chrome
    - heading "Browsing boosted with built-in AI" [level=2]
    - img "A pop-up over a cake recipe webpage asks how Gemini in Chrome can help. The feature is on both desktop and mobile."
    - 'heading "Gemini in Chrome: Your AI browsing assistant" [level=3]'
    - paragraph: Gemini in Chrome helps you easily understand content on the web and get things done using the context of your open tabs and browsing history. Plus, with auto browse, Gemini in Chrome can do your tedious tasks for you* – from shopping and reservations, to research and more.
    - paragraph: "*Auto browse available only to Google AI Ultra and Pro subscribers in the U.S."
    - link "Open in the same tab":
      - /url: /chrome/ai-innovations/
      - text: Explore Gemini in Chrome
    - paragraph: Gemini in Chrome can do tasks for you with auto browse. Available to Google AI Pro and Ultra subscribers in the U.S.
    - link "Sign up now":
      - /url: http://one.google.com/ai
    - list:
      - listitem:
        - heading "NANO BANANA – GEMINI IN CHROME" [level=3]
        - heading "Make online inspiration your own creation" [level=4]
        - img "A user asks Gemini in Chrome to add light contemporary furniture to an image of a living room from a webpage"
        - button "Flip card"
      - listitem:
        - heading "SKILLS – GEMINI IN CHROME" [level=3]
        - heading "Your most helpful prompts in one click" [level=4]
        - img "A variety of Gemini in Chrome skills related to online shopping, like summarize reviews, get sizing help, or check returns"
        - button "Flip card"
    - heading "GOOGLE SEARCH" [level=2]
    - heading "Ask anything with AI Mode" [level=3]
    - paragraph: AI Mode is our most powerful AI search, built right into Chrome. Ask your toughest questions from the place where you already search, and keep exploring with follow-up questions and helpful web links.
    - link "Open in the same tab":
      - /url: /chrome/ai-innovations/#ai-mode
      - text: Explore AI Mode
    - heading "Make it yours and take it with you" [level=2]
    - heading "Think outside the top bar with vertical tabs" [level=2]
    - paragraph: Vertical tabs stack down the side of your browser window, so you can read full page titles and manage tab groups with ease – even when your tab count hits double digits. Just right-click on any Chrome window and select “Show Tabs Vertically.”
    - link "Get help with managing tabs":
      - /url: https://support.google.com/chrome/answer/2391819
    - region:
      - list:
        - listitem:
          - button "One window, two views" [expanded]:
            - heading "One window, two views" [level=3]
          - paragraph: Sick of juggling multiple windows or switching between tabs? Split view lets you view two tabs at the same time for a more streamlined, flexible way to work.
          - img "While on a Google Meet call, a user pulls a Google Doc from a separate tab into split view to take notes more efficiently"
        - listitem:
          - button "Customize your Chrome":
            - heading "Customize your Chrome" [level=3]
          - paragraph: Personalize your web browser with themes, dark mode and other options built just for you.
          - link "Explore themes":
            - /url: https://chrome.google.com/webstore/category/themes
          - img "Icons display nine different themes. If the user clicks the theme the background image will change."
        - listitem:
          - button "Browse across devices":
            - heading "Browse across devices" [level=3]
          - paragraph: Sign in to Chrome on any device to access your bookmarks, saved passwords, and more.
          - img "A mobile browser loads tabs from a desktop browser, including Google Maps and NYC parking info."
        - listitem:
          - button "Save time with autofill":
            - heading "Save time with autofill" [level=3]
          - paragraph: Use Chrome to save addresses, passwords, and more to quickly autofill your details.
          - img "A user is able to instantly enter their name and address to a form using autofill."
      - link "Sign in to get started":
        - /url: http://accounts.google.com

        - paragraph: Chrome has tools to help you manage the tabs you’re not quite ready to close. Group, label, and color code your tabs to stay organized and work faster.
        - 'img "A browser UI features three groups of tabs: Personal, Trip to Arches, and Work."'
      - listitem:

        - paragraph: Chrome is built to work with your device across platforms. That means a smooth experience on whatever you’re working with.

Network content is retained only when selected; response bytes are browser-decoded, not compressed wire bytes.
Request bytes are limited to what Playwright exposes; not_exposed does not establish body absence or multipart file coverage.
Network content reads settle within 5 seconds each and never wait for unfinished responses or refetch them.
Playwright scenario events do not expose request initiator stacks; receipt order does not prove causality.
Storage values are hashed only after declared-secret redaction.
